systems.system: المنظومة الإلكترونية الموحدة (National Diabetes Authority unified electronic system)

note: A single sectoral system for patient registration and drug distribution, linked to the national number for insulin dispensing; no exchange between health systems is stated.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Health announced the activation of an integrated electronic system connecting the Ministry's pharmacy department, the Medical Supply Organisation and hospital pharmacy departments to track medicines from arrival to dispensing; no platform name or coverage figure is given.

systems.owner: Health Information and Documentation Centre, Ministry of Health

note: Describes a single system, DHIS2, for routine facility data collection; the civil registry cooperation is joint report preparation, not a stated data exchange between systems.
